diagnostics.message: The rendered artifact overflows the 1440x900 light viewport.

evidence.pageCompositionMeasurement: CSS pixels at this viewport; body padding, header, diagram chrome, SVG and cards stack vertically and sum to scrollHeight
evidence.measurement: CSS pixels; rendered node boxes geometrically contained in each lane frame; spaces include headers and routing, not guaranteed removable space

supportedFixes: the page is 508px too tall (12px body padding + 52px header + 78px diagram chrome + 1260px SVG + 6px cards = 1408px against 900px); the SVG spans the full 1346px reader width because its viewBox ratio is below 1.55 and it declares no intrinsic-height fit, so the Reader can neither narrow it nor accept readable vertical scroll: either remove meta.viewBox so the renderer sizes the canvas and declares the fit, or make the viewBox at least 1.55x wider than tall
run validate workflow <source.json> --layout-json and compare the tallest rendered lane frames with source lanes, col and yOffset; frame IDs are rendered indices, not source lane IDs
